name: Commuting a CZ past a CNOT target
summary: A CZ on the target of a CNOT can be moved through it at the cost of an extra CZ on the control.
description:
A CZ gate acting on the target qubit of a CNOT can be commuted through the CNOT by adding a CZ between the control of the CNOT and the other qubit of the CZ. It is the [colour-changed](../colour-change/) version of [commuting CNOTs](../cnot-target-control-commutation/): with a Hadamard on the third qubit, the CZ becomes a CNOT whose control is the CNOT's target.

Rules like this are the basis of algorithms that push CZ gates through CNOT circuits, for instance when extracting circuits from graph-like diagrams.
